description: KJ Admin (KaoJai admin console) connects authorized KaoJai businesses to inspect chats, bookings, and Help Desk cases, and prepare confirmation-gated customer replies.

defaultPrompt: Show the businesses I can access.
Summarize recent customer conversations in my business.
Show my booking activities and available times.
interface.longDescription:
KJ Admin (KaoJai admin console) connects your authorized KaoJai business workspace to ChatGPT. Choose an enabled business, review recent conversations, search conversation names and message text, read messages, inspect booking information and availability, and read Help Desk cases.

For customer replies, KJ admin prepares an exact recipient and text preview first. Sending requires a separate, later confirmation and an eligible connected messaging provider. Provider acceptance does not mean the customer has received or read the message.

Connect a KaoJai account with an enabled MCP connection. Access to business data requires current owner or admin permissions and the permissions you grant. Message-text search and message reads support periods of up to 30 days; conversation names can be searched across all time.

Booking and Help Desk tools inspect existing records only. The plugin does not create, change, or cancel bookings, close or delete cases, contact arbitrary recipients, or process payments.

With optional workspace.setting permission, current business owners and admins can update the selected business description and HTTPS logo URL. This permission is independent of workspace.action. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears a field. It does not grant access to billing, credentials, or member management.

publication.release_notes: Request read, action, and settings scopes on every OAuth connection; users can still decline optional action and settings permissions.

th-TH.description:
เชื่อมต่อพื้นที่ธุรกิจ KaoJai ของคุณกับ ChatGPT เพื่อค้นหาบทสนทนา อ่านและสรุปข้อความลูกค้า ตรวจสอบข้อมูลการจอง ช่วงเวลาว่างและราคา รวมถึงดูรายละเอียดเคส Help Desk

เลือกธุรกิจที่ต้องการใช้งาน และเข้าถึงข้อมูลตามสิทธิ์เจ้าของหรือผู้ดูแลระบบที่คุณอนุญาต สำหรับการตอบลูกค้า KJ admin จะแสดงผู้รับและข้อความให้ตรวจสอบก่อน โดยต้องได้รับการยืนยันจากคุณอีกครั้งจึงจะส่งผ่านช่องทางที่รองรับได้ การรับข้อความโดยผู้ให้บริการไม่ได้หมายความว่าลูกค้าได้รับหรืออ่านข้อความแล้ว

ต้องใช้บัญชี KaoJai ที่เปิดใช้งานการเชื่อมต่อ MCP การค้นหาเนื้อหาข้อความและการอ่านข้อความรองรับช่วงเวลาสูงสุด 30 วัน ส่วนการค้นหาชื่อบทสนทนาทำได้ทุกช่วงเวลา

เครื่องมือการจองและ Help Desk ใช้ดูข้อมูลที่มีอยู่เท่านั้น ไม่รองรับการสร้าง แก้ไข หรือยกเลิกการจอง การปิดหรือลบเคส การส่งข้อความถึงผู้รับนอกบทสนทนาที่ได้รับอนุญาต หรือการชำระเงิน

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, process payments, or offer purchases.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account has two active owner/admin grants named Review Primary and Review Secondary. Start a fresh OAuth session with no selected business. Both grants must be enabled for MCP. This checks business selection and session scope.
positive.prompt: Which businesses can I access? Use Review Primary for this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the authenticated account grants. Select Review Primary with tenant_option_id copied from that session’s returned option_id; do not guess an identifier. Confirm the business and returned permissions. Do not fetch workspace records before selection.

positive.description: Select Review Primary. Seed one existing sample conversation named Review Customer containing a customer message with the phrase delivery question within the latest 30 days, and an unrelated conversation without the phrase. No real customer data.
positive.prompt: Find conversations containing "delivery question" from the last 7 days, and summarize the messages in the matching conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with query="delivery question" and explicit time_from/time_to spanning the last 7 days, at most 30 days. Read only returned conversation_id values using the same period. Distinguish all-time display-name matches from message-text matches; summarize actual returned messages, respecting pagination and without inventing missing history.

positive.description: Select Review Primary with booking access. Seed one sample activity named Review Court with at least one available resource/slot on 2030-01-15. The reviewer must verify availability fixtures before running.
positive.prompt: Show the available times and prices for Review Court on January 15, 2030.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Review Court from booking_get_catalog, then call booking_check_availability with its returned activity_id and date="2030-01-15". Report only returned slots, resources, and prices, retaining venue context. Do not create, change, or cancel any booking.

positive.description: Select Review Primary with Help Desk read permission. Seed a sample case titled Review Delivery Issue. The case must appear in the list returned to this account.
positive.prompt: Find the Help Desk case "Review Delivery Issue" and show its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the named case from helpdesk_list_cases, following returned cursors if necessary, then call helpdesk_get_case with exactly its returned case_id. Present returned details without changing status, assignee, or case content. Report no match truthfully rather than fabricate a case.

positive.description: Select Review Primary with chat send permission and an existing sample conversation named Review Customer connected to a dedicated sandbox recipient. The reviewer ends this case before confirmation; no external send is needed.
positive.prompt: Draft a reply to Review Customer: "Your order is ready for collection." Show me the recipient and text for approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the existing conversation with query="Review Customer" and use its returned conversation_id and reply target when required. Prepare exactly "Your order is ready for collection." Show the exact recipient and preview. Wait for a later explicit user confirmation; never call chat_send_message in this case or expose the confirmation token.

negative.description: Booking mutations are unsupported. Explain that booking creation/change/cancellation must be completed in KaoJai Admin; invoke no KJ admin tool and do not claim cancellation.
Sending to arbitrary recipients is unsupported. Explain that replies require an existing authorized business conversation; invoke no KJ admin tool and do not claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Text a new phone number and invite them to our event.

negative.description: Case mutations are unsupported. Explain that closing/deleting cases must be completed in KaoJai Admin; invoke no KJ admin tool and do not claim a case was changed.
negative.prompt: Close and delete all of our Help Desk cases.
